text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — Sev2: GPU OOM during prefill on pool-prod-3. node=gpu-17 container=runtime-8 restart_count=3. Potential customer impact: elevated latencies, some requests retried.

sre-oncall: Looking. Can someone confirm which model and prompt size?

lydia: Early logs show long-context user payload ~1.1M tokens (after encoding) — model=redwood-30b-ctx, seq_len ~600k. Prefill appears to allocate massive KV cache and then container hits OOM.

omar: OOM stack snippet from /var/log/containers/runtime-8.log:
```
E tensorflow: cudart failed: out of memory (2) 
...GPU memory alloc failure at allocator.cu:123
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
```

jess: Node gpu-17 is flapping: docker restart loop every ~20s. kube events show OOMKilled -> restart -> prefill -> OOMKilled.

mike-support: Customer ops reported retries visible around 2024-10-11T03:12Z, ~5% 5xx on embeddings route. Not full outage but user impact on heavy context workloads.

product-ops: Which mitigation do we want to apply first? Canary smaller model? Throttle prefill size? Evict KV?

sre-oncall: Immediate mitigation plan (fast):
- Add temporary request-level prefill token cap via routing rule to 200k tokens for pool-prod-3.
- Route long-context requests to fallback model variant redwood-30b-ctx-lite (reduced KV per layer).
- Mark node gpu-17 unschedulable and cordon it to stop further restarts.

lydia: I'm pushing the routing rule now (rbac + console). Command: `redctl routes update --pool pool-prod-3 --prefill-max-tokens 200000 --reason "live mitigation 6950012345"`

incident-bot: Change accepted and queued — rollout id=rr-8145.

omar: I manually cordoned gpu-17: `kubectl cordon gpu-17` and evicted runtime-8 pods to allow node to come back clean. Restart frequency dropped.

jess: After evicting, we saw containers come up on gpu-21 and gpu-22 with fallback model, no restarts so far.

mike-support: Sending customer update: "We observed elevated errors for very long-context requests and applied a routing rule to limit prefill size and use a fallback model. We're investigating root cause and will follow up"

product-ops: Can we get a short post-incident action list?

sre-oncall: Initial postmortem items:
- Add server-side hard cap on prefill KV allocation and guardrails for >200k tokens.
- Improve validation in router to reject/route >1M token requests by default.
- Add early backpressure in SDK to prevent accidental huge payloads.
- Telemetry: add per-request encoded token histogram and tag large-prefill traces.
- Consider adaptive eviction: proactively trim KV for prefills over X tokens.

lydia: Filing follow-up tickets now and will attach logs + heap dumps. Ticket: INF-2319 prefillsafe-guard.

omar: For immediate_code: we should update the graceful fallback policy to pick models with lower KV growth before eviction. I'll patch the fallback matrix.

jess: Monitoring: set alert to trigger at >1 OOM restart per node per 10m and to notify eng-runtime separate channel.

mike-support: Customer comms scheduled in 30m to impacted tenants.

incident-bot: Incident annotated with tags: [gpu_oom, prefill, long_context, live_mitigation]. Pager closed to oncall at 6950012508.

sre-oncall: Closing thread — follow-ups assigned. If anyone sees restart loop reappear, @sre-oncall please re-open. :white_check_mark:
